settings.heading: Rooted in Nature. Refined by Intention.
settings.text_paragraph_1: At Aryvan, botanical wellness is rooted in reverence for the earth. We honor the innate complexity of living botanicals, bridging ancestral herbal traditions with meticulous modern craftsmanship.
settings.text_paragraph_2: Each formulation is slow-macerated in small artisanal vessels, ensuring delicate volatile essences, terpenes, and plant sterols remain unadulterated and biologically resonant.
settings.quote: True wellness is not created in haste. It is distilled through patience, reverence, and nature's quiet wisdom.

settings.title: Whole-Plant Integrity
settings.description: Utilizing complete botanical aerials, leaves, and roots to preserve the full biological synergy of nature's phytochemical spectrum.

settings.title: Botanical Extraction
settings.description: Gentle ambient and cold-oil maceration without extreme thermal degradation, keeping plant sterols and terpenes intact.

settings.title: Thoughtful Formulation

settings.heading: Whole-Plant Science & Intentional Alchemy
settings.text: We formulate exclusively with whole-plant botanicals, cold infusions, and biodynamic extracts to respect the living integrity of nature.

settings.title: Thoughtfully Sourced

settings.title: Nature-Inspired Formulations
